artifactRadiusSteps.doc: The levels at which a WORLD relic's spell widens a ring (09-relics.md §2.2). A city relic's aura grows by `cityLevels` instead.

cityLevels.doc: How a CITY relic grows (09-relics.md §2.1): each level-up from level 2 raises one of three things, in this order, round and round.

cycle.doc: Level 2 raises the first, level 3 the second, level 4 the third, level 5 the first again. window: the activation lasts the next entry of windowMinutes. radius: the aura reaches one ring further. effect: the relic's number rises by its passivePerLevel. Each must appear once.

windowMinutes.doc: How long an activation lasts: entry 0 at level 1, one entry further at every window step. A window step past the last entry raises the effect instead.

keystoneOneIn.doc: A fragment that drops is the keystone one time in this many.

keystoneWorth.doc: What a spare keystone counts for towards a replica's spares.

levelStardustBase.doc: Stardust the first level-up costs (level 1 to 2). Every level-up also takes one fragment of each of the six slots.

levelStardustGrowth.doc: Each level-up costs this many times the one before, rounded to three figures.

replicaFreeSparesPiece.doc: Spares that forge a missing piece without Gems.

replicaFreeSparesKeystone.doc: Spares that forge the missing keystone without Gems.

replicaSpares.doc: Spares the Gem forge takes besides its Gems.

replicaGemsPiece.doc: Gems the forge asks for a piece.

replicaGemsKeystone.doc: Gems the forge asks for the keystone.

fragmentPackGems.doc: The store's fragment pack: its Gem price.

fragmentPackSize.doc: The store's fragment pack: bound fragments of relics already met, at random.

treasureEvery.doc: Every this many fog treasures, one city fragment comes too. 0: never.

perLairTier.doc: City fragments a lair's prize pays, by its tier.

perPackTier.doc: What a pack the save or a world source still names is worth in fragments.

premiumGems.doc: The Shrines built anywhere for Gems: one price each, in order; how many there are is how long this is.
